    h=len(inp); w=len(inp[0])
    bg=inp[0][0]
    hr=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(inp[r]))==1 and inp[r][0]!=bg]
    vc=[c for c in range(w) if len({inp[i][c] for i in range(h)})==1 and inp[0][c]!=bg]
    sep=hr[0] if hr else vc[0]; axis='h' if hr else 'v'
    cells=[(i,j,inp[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w)
           if inp[i][j]!=bg and not (axis=='h' and i==sep) and not (axis=='v' and j==sep)]
    if not cells: return inp
    rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
    span = max(rs)-min(rs)+1 if axis=='h' else max(cs)-min(cs)+1
    dir_ = 1 if ((axis=='h' and min(rs)>sep) or (axis=='v' and min(cs)>sep)) else -1
    F = sep + dir_*(span+1)
    edge = min(rs) if (axis=='h' and dir_==-1) else (max(rs) if (axis=='h' and dir_==1) else min(cs) if (axis=='v' and dir_==-1) else max(cs))
    shift_row = (F-dir_)-edge   # new leading edge position minus old leading edge
    o=[r[:] for r in inp]
    # clear original object
    for i,j,v in cells: o[i][j]=bg
    # draw fill
    if axis=='h':
        for c in range(w): o[F][c]=8
        for i,j,v in cells: o[i+shift_row][j]=v
    else:
        for r in range(h): o[r][F]=8
        for i,j,v in cells: o[i][j+shift_row]=v
    return o
